name: block-push-auth-loop
description: Blocks `git push` or `gh auth login` once the journal written by the companion record-push-outcome hook shows 2 consecutive git-push authentication failures within 30 minutes -- a deterministic loop-breaker for the repeated-login problem, enforcing references/git-push-auth-recovery.md's stop rule without relying on the model remembering to stop. Requires record-push-outcome installed alongside it (same journal file); by itself it always allows (no journal, no block). Generic across any git repository.
